description: Sanity checks for the impact skill. These are not automated regression tests — they're scenarios a reviewer or skill-creator harness can walk through manually to verify trigger accuracy and output usefulness.

cases.input: I just edited apps/web/src/lib/useFoo.ts — what does this change affect?
What tests should I run after editing packages/shared/lib/agent/coreTools.ts?
What's the blast radius of renaming this hook?
Where is the function loadConsent defined?
cases.expect: skill NOT invoked — should use Serena find_symbol

cases.input: Update the README to mention the new flag.
Find all call sites of useAuth().signOut
cases.expect: skill NOT invoked — symbol-level lookup, use Serena find_referencing_symbols

cases.scenario: Run impact.sh on a branch with no code changes
Run impact.sh on a repo where neither madge nor dependency-cruiser is installed
cases.expect: warns about degraded mode on stderr, still produces a one-hop report from grep fallback

cases.scenario: Run impact.sh against an edit in packages/shared on a pnpm-workspace repo with apps/web and apps/mobile both consuming shared
cases.expect: reverse-deps section lists @kindred-mama/web and @kindred-mama/mobile as separate groups

cases.scenario: Run impact.sh on a file containing `import(someVar)`
cases.expect: Caveats section reports 'N dynamic import() call(s) detected'
